description: Development of the Hamilton Canal and the associated aquatic environment as a place of Tourist attraction
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-11-02 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Plans are underway to implement development projects for the coastal and marine-associated environments in the Western Province including the Hamilton Canal, the Negombo Lagoon and the associated aquatic environment as a nature centric tourism destination development programme that reflects the historical heritage. Against this backdrop, the Western Provincial Council has prepared a project Report for the development of the Hamilton Canal from the King’s Island jetty (Negombo Lagoon) to Ma Oya estuary for tourism purposes. Accordingly, the joint proposal made by the Minister of Foreign Affairs, Foreign Employment and Tourism, and the Minister of Public Administration, Provincial Councils and Local Government to implement the project for the Development of the Hamilton Canal and the associated aquatic environment as a place of Tourist attraction, utilizing the funds from the Sri Lanka Tourism Promotion Bureau at an estimated cost of Rs.700 million, was approved by the Cabinet.
